title: The Don
desc: The story of a common man, who later becomes a Don, who always stands for justice and poor against all odds and evil minds.

title: Hariyali Aur Rasta
desc: A man's marriage is fixed from his childhood, but he falls for another woman. Though he marries his elders' choice, the ill-fitting union is thrown into disarray when the man's old flame re-enters his life.

title: Mera Pati Sirf Mera Hai
desc: Roopa does not get along with Prakash, her husband, and suspects he is having an affair. Things take a turn when she starts spreading vile rumours about Sharda, a woman living next door.

title: Ghar Jamai
desc: Dwarka, a millionaire, is impressed by Anil, a principled man, and wants him to marry Mona, his daughter. However, after their marriage, he compels him to move into his house.
